# Bressler, Amery & Ross, P.C.

> > Full-service law firm specializing in insurance coverage, securities regulation, environmental litigation, and tribal law with offices across New Jersey, New York, and Florida.

Bressler, Amery & Ross, P.C. is a nationally recognized law firm providing sophisticated legal services across multiple practice areas including insurance disputes, FINRA compliance, environmental law, and automotive franchise representation. The firm is active in legal education through webinars and seminars, and maintains strong community involvement through charitable sponsorships.

## Key Topics

- Insurance coverage disputes and bad faith claims
- Securities law and FINRA regulatory compliance
- Senior investor protection and financial exploitation
- Environmental litigation (CERCLA, Superfund, RCRA)
- Tribal Federal Indian Law and gaming regulation
- Automotive dealer and franchise law
- Elder fraud prevention
- New Jersey State Bar Association programs
- Legal ethics and in-house counsel guidance
- Pro bono legal services
- COVID-19 corporate and IP issues
- Fixed income sales and trading compliance
- Policy interpretation and extra-contractual liability

## Practice Areas

- [Insurance Coverage Disputes & Bad Faith Claims](https://www.bressler.com/practices-insurance-coverage-disputes-bad-faith-claims): Insurance litigation practice for coverage disputes & bad faith claims
- [Environmental Litigation](https://www.bressler.com/practices-environmental-litigation): Environmental litigation including CERCLA, Superfund, RCRA & Clean Water Act
- [Tribal Federal Indian Law](https://www.bressler.com/practices-Tribal-Federal-Indian-Law): Tribal sovereignty, gaming regulation, treaty rights & federal Indian law

## Industry Focus

- [Automotive & Transportation](https://www.bressler.com/industries-automotive-transportation): Auto dealer representation, franchise law & transportation industry services

- [Senior Bootcamp for New Jersey BDs and IAs](https://www.bressler.com/event-bressler-hosts-senior-bootcamp-for-smallmedium-sized-new-jersey-bds-and-ias): Senior bootcamp for NJ broker-dealers on investor protection & compliance
- [How to Arbitrate a Securities Case](https://www.bressler.com/event-how-to-arbitrate-a-securities-case-a-practical-program): Frank Cuccio presents on securities arbitration at NJ State Bar Association
